name: Cable Lat Pulldown
instructions: Grip bar slightly wider than shoulders. Sit tall with thighs secure under pads. Pull bar smoothly down to upper chest while squeezing shoulder blades together. Slowly return with controlled resistance.
safety: Do not jerk body backwards or pull behind neck.

name: Leg Press 45-Degree Sled
instructions: Place feet hip-width apart on platform. Disengage safety bars. Lower weight smoothly until knees are at 90 degrees. Press through midfoot and heels to return without locking knees.
safety: Never lock knees out at the top of the repetition.

name: Concept2 Indoor Rower
instructions: Sequence: Legs drive, hip hinge backward, arms pull to sternum. Recovery: arms extend forward, hips hinge forward, knees bend returning to catch position.
safety: Maintain a neutral spine; avoid rounding lower back.
